definition.def: If something is graded, its quality is judged, and it is often given a number or a name that indicates how good or bad it is.
examples: Dust masks are graded according to the protection they offer. [be VERB-ed]
South Point College does not grade the students' work. [VERB noun]

definition.def: The grade of a product is its quality, especially when this has been officially judged.
Your grade in an examination or piece of written work is the mark you get, usually in the form of a letter or number, that indicates your level of achievement.
examples: What grade are you hoping to get?
There was a lot of pressure on you to obtain good grades.

definition.def: Your grade in a company or organization is your level of importance or your rank.
examples: Staff turnover is particularly high among junior grades.

definition.def: In the United States, a grade is a group of classes in which all the children are of a similar age. When you are six years old you go into the first grade and you leave school after the twelfth grade.
examples: Mr White teaches first grade in south Georgia.
She drove up a steep grade and then began the long descent into the desert.
I was a naval officer, lieutenant junior grade.

definition.def: If someone makes the grade, they succeed, especially by reaching a particular standard.
examples: She had a strong desire to be a dancer but failed to make the grade.

examples.sentence: As I wrote, I kept in mind two types of readers: those who enjoyed mathematics until they were turned off by an unpleasant episode, usually around fifth grade, and mathematics aficionados, who will find much that is new throughout the book.
By the middle of the 19th century, production of cinnamon reached 1,000 tons a year, after a lower grade quality of the spice became acceptable to European tastes.

Lower secondary schools in Japan cover three school years, from the seventh grade (age 13) to the ninth grade (age 15).
Actually, we got a top research grade of 5 for engineering, geography and computer sciences.
It's more, I knew exactly what I had to do to get a good grade at school, and I knew I'd be expected to go more deeply into things here.
But I haven't got information on how the lecturer is going to grade my work, what he's looking for.
